links.outcome: AUC of ML models versus human experts and other algorithms in external validation set
links.effect: Operator splitting neural network AUC 0.66 vs XGBoost 0.58, logistic regression 0.55, human experts 0.47-0.53 for clinical responder status; patient-reported improvement AUC 0.64 vs experts 0.41-0.62.
links.quote: In the validation set, the operator splitting neural network had AUC of 0.66 and outperformed XGBoost with DART (top available machine-learning classifier, AUC: 0.58), logistic regression (AUC 0.55), and human experts (AUC 0.47-0.53) for prediction of clinical responder status.

screen.reason: Retrospective external validation study comparing an algorithmic predictive model against standard ML baselines and human experts using clinical trial datasets.
